findings.note: No fixture in this suite contains a Capability that matches no affected component. full-pipeline-match declares exactly two Capabilities and both match (cap-alpha via comp-a pii:true, cap-beta via comp-b ui:true); enforcement-byte-identity's cap-solo matches comp-a; the three warn-cardinality Capabilities WARN rather than cleanly no-match. REQ-006 item (b) ('a Capability whose trigger matches none'), which tasks.md and traceability.md both assign to T-005, therefore has no fixture at all. The consequence is not bookkeeping: design.md step 10a assembles the Facet Manifest from 'every MATCHED Capability's required_facets/gate_ids/lite_policy/minimum_enforcement', and with every Registry Capability matched, all five of AC-007's aggregate fields are confounded between 'aggregate over the matched set' and 'aggregate over the whole Registry' -- required_facets (['core-facet'] either way), capabilities (both ids either way), resolved_gates (gate-impl+gate-artifact either way), capability_minimum_enforcement ('required' either way), lite_eligibility (false either way). The five PASS lines labelled '(AC-007)' cannot fail under a mutation that drops the matched-set gate. The suite's own recorded survivor MUT-7 ('_required_facets ignoring the matched set ... survives because both fixture Capabilities already match') is one instance of this five-field class, carried open unremediated through gate cycles 2-5. Closing it is a pure fixture change inside T-005's own Planned Files: a third Capability whose trigger matches no component, carrying its own required_facets/gate_ids/lite_policy that must NOT appear in the assembled Manifest.

AC-056's governing cardinality claim -- 'exactly one severity: warn entry per INDIVIDUAL outcome: warn DSL-evaluation node' -- is not discriminated by any fixture. Every trigger/when predicate in all three WARN fixtures is a flat leaf node, so each evidence tree yields at most one warn node: warn-cardinality-multi-node produces 3 trees x 1 node (one per component, comp-a/b/c, all lacking a characteristics key), and warn-cardinality-facet-node produces 2 trees x 1 node (comp-b's trigger warn and comp-b's facet warn). 'Per node' is therefore indistinguishable from 'per evidence tree' in every case, and the assertions 'exactly 3 severity:warn entries, one per outcome:warn node, never fewer' / 'exactly 2 ...' hold identically under a mutant that emits only the first warn node of each tree. This is the suite's own recorded survivor MUT-9, still open after gate cycles 3-5 (the facet-node fixture added in cycle 4 kills 'per component' but not 'per node'). The Registry DSL admits all/any/not composite nodes with children (investigation.md INV-005; contracts predicate definition), and the shared expected_warn_diagnostic helper already renders node_path into the detail string -- so a single composite predicate whose children both WARN on one component is the discriminating input the criterion names, and it appears in no fixture.

AC-016's Facet-Manifest half is carried by a structural proxy only -- the assertion '_assemble_facet_manifest takes no state/capability_enforcement parameter (structural proof the Facet Manifest itself is enforcement-independent on the Full track)'. The driver already reconstructs a Facet Manifest via _assemble_facet_manifest for the primary fixture, so diffing the advisory- and required-fixture reconstructions directly is available and strictly stronger; a signature check cannot see enforcement reaching the assembler through module-level state or through a field of an input it does receive.
